title: Phase A 5/8: Gherkin specs for the Videos, Findings and section list pages in every case
description:
Phase A, step 5. Gherkin specs and their steps for the new anatomy (behaviour changes need specs: AGENTS.md). Plain-words scenario lists below are the spec; step code goes in features/steps/reference_list_steps.py (new; move what is reused from references_by_section_steps.py, sectioned_page_steps.py and site_steps.py rather than duplicating). Cases come from the fixture task (`project_reference_case`). "Reaches" means: the lead's cards + the stream's first page + every chunk JSON file reached by following `next` from the stream's data-src, by card address, after the hook ran (chunk files are written through page_finish).

1. features/reference-lists.feature (rewrite; title "Every video and finding can be reached, however many are filed under a section"). Narrative: the owner's vision in two sentences, the three cases, no heading on the unfiled lists, order rule.
   - Outline over /videos/ (videos) and /findings/ (findings), case "none": the page has no heading other than its title; the first block after the page header has 4 cards (one row of one, then one row of three) and no heading; then a list with no heading whose first page has 60 cards and a Load more link; lead + list + chunk files reach all 200 exactly once; the page never contains "All videos", "All findings" or "Not in a section yet".
   - Outline, case "some": the lead holds the 4 best unfiled items in the shared order; there is a block for Privacy & Security, Science and Agents and none for Papyrus or History; the list holds every other unfiled item; the Papyrus items are in the lead or the list and carry their section chip; no address appears twice across lead, blocks, list and chunk files.
   - Outline, case "all": no lead, no list, no Load more, no empty sentence; the first block is Privacy & Security with the feature layout.
   - Outline, case "few": the lead holds both unfiled items in one row of two; there is no list and no Load more.
   - Outline, case "empty": the page shows "No videos have been accepted yet." / "Nothing has been accepted yet." and no block.
   - Scenario: a publication that declares no sections: case "some" projected with `declares_sections=False`: /videos/ has a lead and a list (lead + list + chunk files reach all 170 videos exactly once) and no block; no /security/videos/ page exists.
   - Scenario: order: case "none", the lead's first card is this week's highest-starred video, and the five-star video accepted 20 days ago comes after every video accepted in the last seven days.
   - Scenario: a page of the list is a real page a reader without a script can follow (chunk index.html exists, has the site chrome, Previous/Next links).
   - Scenario: findings never show a video: case "some", no card on /findings/, its chunk files, /security/findings/ or the /security/ findings panel has a medium chip, and the case's videos are absent by address.
   - Scenario: the stylesheet hides an empty list and no longer has `.mom-untagged` or `.mom-all-refs`; js/papyrus-reference-list.js exists.
2. features/references-by-section.feature (update, main fixture site plus cases):
   - Outline /videos/, /findings/: the block "Privacy & Security" links its title to /security/videos/ (/security/findings/) and ends with "More Privacy & Security videos…" ("… findings…") linking to the same place; "Science" with one item has no More link.
   - A section with no page (Papyrus) has no block (replaces "has no link to a section page").
   - With a lead (case "some") the first block has the "wide" layout (6 cards) and no block has the feature layout; without one (case "all") the first block has the feature layout.
   - No block head shows a count such as "12 videos".
   - Keep the ordering scenarios (sections by best item; stars inside this week; older week after) and the "no Reference listed twice", "videos only list videos" and Markdown twin scenarios; drop "The big Accepted header is gone" only if it no longer adds anything.
3. features/section-lists.feature (new): "A section's own list of videos and of findings".
   - case "all": /security/videos/ has the title "Privacy & Security videos", the sentence "Every video filed under Privacy & Security, this week's best first.", no other heading, a lead of 4 and a list; lead + list + chunk files reach all 70 exactly once.
   - Same for /security/findings/ ("Privacy & Security findings"), and none of its cards is a video.
   - /history/videos/ shows "No videos in History yet." and /history/findings/ shows "No findings in History yet.".
   - Every section in web/sections.json has both list pages.
4. features/section-pages.feature (add): the findings panel: case "some", /security/ shows at most 3 findings in one row, none a video, under the heading "Findings" linked to /security/findings/, then "More findings…" to /security/findings/; /science/ (4 findings) shows 3 and the More link; /agents/ (1) shows 1 and no More link; /history/ has no findings panel. Update the existing scenario that says the section page has no videos panel and no conversations so it also says no findings panel where it applies.
5. Remove step definitions no scenario uses any more ("headed 'All videos'", "Not in a section yet").

Acceptance: `behave features/` passes (browser scenarios skip without Playwright); `python3 -m pytest tests/` passes.
